what: Audiogram: a waveform that scrolls with the real level of the voice, speaker and show on a card, the phrase karaoke-style with the stressed word in the accent
title: Your Name | Your Show
intent: Turn a voice clip into something people watch with the sound off and listen to with it on
action: A waveform scrolls with the voice's level; a live dot pulses with it; the phrase being said fills the middle, said words in full colour, coming words dim, the stressed one in red; a progress line runs along the bottom
make_it_yours: Title is "Speaker | Show". Put the clip in assets/, get word timings, run voice_plan.py: voice.json brings the words, the phrases, the stressed words and the voice's level per frame.
craft_note: Everything that moves comes from the voice: the frame rests when the person pauses. Coming words at a third let the eye read ahead without spoiling the phrase.
look: Podcast card: near-black, warm white, one red accent, mono for the show name
